finalText:
Fixed it. The error was buried in line 599: `src/core/settings.js` referenced an undefined variable `retries`. The code tried to assign it to `maxRetries` but the variable never existed.

I added `maxRetries: 3` to the DEFAULTS object and changed the assignment to use the environment variable with a fallback to the default, matching the pattern used for the other config values. Build now completes clean with 0 errors.
